confidence_notes: Naha crowdsourced data are sparse, and some observations postdate July 2026. Food estimates draw on [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Naha-Japan) and [Livingcost](https://livingcost.org/cost/japan/naha). Cocktail and wine estimates use their relationship to beer and a [local drink menu](https://www.arrange-okinawa.jp/drink/). Accommodation is a holistic estimate with substantial seasonal uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use regional Japanese cities such as Kagoshima as a general basis, adjusted for Okinawa's island tourism and July demand.
